import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """model,random_split_accuracy,random_split_kappa,spatial_block_accuracy,spatial_block_kappa,points,blocks
random forest,0.96695,0.96289,0.81897,0.79527,2320,47
gradient boosting,0.98276,0.98064,0.83319,0.81144,2320,47
SVM (RBF),0.97414,0.97096,0.85043,0.83101,2320,47
k-nearest neighbours,0.96552,0.96128,0.83017,0.80835,2320,47
logistic regression,0.97414,0.97096,0.85388,0.83498,2320,47
ensemble: soft vote,0.97701,0.97419,0.84741,0.82748,2320,47
ensemble: stacking,0.97557,0.97258,0.8556,0.83674,2320,47
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_validation(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2, 3.6))
    y = np.arange(len(df))
    ax.barh(y + 0.2, df.random_split_accuracy, 0.4, color="#9aa5b1", label="random 70/30 split")
    ax.barh(y - 0.2, df.spatial_block_accuracy, 0.4, color="#2a78d6",
            label="spatial blocks held out")
    ax.set_yticks(y, df.model, fontsize=8)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_xlabel("Overall accuracy")
    ax.set_title("Same models, two validations", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
    return fig

plot_validation(df)
plt.show()
